description: Keyword/heuristic trigger coverage against SKILL.md frontmatter description. Not an LLM eval — CI gates regressions when trigger keywords drift.
how_to_extend: Add a positive query that should select this skill (报告/路演/PPT/HTML/调研…).
Add a negative query that must NOT select it (coding/video/edit-existing-pptx…).
Runner: python3 scripts/check_triggers.py — matches query tokens against description keywords extracted from SKILL.md.
Wire: package_skill.py --check invokes check_triggers; also npm run check.
